title: scene-wss: missing RFC 8887 4.2 justification
description: RFC 8887 4.2 says other message types MUST NOT be sent over the connection. chat-wss:99 explains how its session capability permits new message types; draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md has no equivalent paragraph for SceneStreamEnable/Disable and the event types.
close_reason: Fixed by jmap-chat-spec-k0pv.1 (scene-wss now has the RFC 8887 update section).
